title: Reject incomplete or unverified Source snapshot authority
summary: Eliminated false-positive acceptance reproduced from PR #6325 (28ab81a03 / 086c5aa70) where get_source_snapshot accepted snapshot-only-ID responses ({snapshot_id: 'mss-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa'}) by fabricating an ID-derived placeholder checksum (checksum = snapshot_id), and _bind_source_snapshot accepted it via truthy skips: 1) _bind_source_snapshot strictly validates full snapshot DTO schema: schema_version, snapshot_id, source_ref, symbol, event_time, observed_at, closes (min 2 positive finite numbers), lineage mapping (source_ids, connector_ids, content_refs, ingest_run_ids), points (validated via canonical LatestMarketSnapshot model and derived SHA24), and rejects ID-derived placeholder checksums; 2) get_source_snapshot API response handler validates full DTO from Source API, verifies canonical points against derived SHA24 via LatestMarketSnapshot.from_dict(), and strictly rejects placeholder checksums; 3) docker compose exec in run_loop_prod_tel_002_hosted_probe.sh wires PANTHEON_SOURCE_INGEST_URL to loop-run-projector-scheduler; 4) All 111 unit, integration, and adversarial QA tests pass with 100% success rate.

counterexamples_eliminated.snapshot_only_id_28ab: Rejected with source_snapshot_api_error; fail-closed when API returns only snapshot_id
counterexamples_eliminated.id_derived_checksum_placeholder: Rejected with invalid_checksum when checksum equals snapshot_id
counterexamples_eliminated.unsupported_schema_version: Rejected with invalid_snapshot_schema when schema_version != source_ingest_latest_market_snapshot.v1
counterexamples_eliminated.insufficient_closes: Rejected with invalid_lineage when closes has < 2 entries or non-positive values
counterexamples_eliminated.corrupted_points_derived_sha: Rejected with invalid_snapshot_id when canonical points do not derive matching snapshot_id

diff_budget.note: Net production line budget <= 150 strictly satisfied with bounded, readable corrective implementation (+90 net lines).
